title: Tiangan-1 Space Poet Project
subtitle: Collaborative project between China Academy of Art and Shanghai Aerospace Exploration Media

mainContent.content: An **IED** collaboration between **China Academy of Art** and **Shanghai Aerospace Exploration Media**: a **space-poetic** narrative object that connects **popular imagination of orbit** with **poetic storytelling**—positioning art and aerospace outreach as **shared cultural infrastructure**.

- Make **distant space programs** emotionally near through **metaphor and scene**.
- Bridge **engineering credibility** with **artistic ambiguity** (the “poet” lens).
- Produce **documentation** that works both as exhibition material and public communication.
